summary: Aether Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 1, 2026, reporting the appointment of Hon Nam Lee (Alvars) as an independent director to fill a newly created seat, expanding the board to five members. Lee will chair the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee and receive a $30,000 annual cash fee plus $5,000 for committee service. Separately, the board approved Timothy William Murphy's transition from independent director to a non-independent director serving as General Counsel. No agreements, arrangements, or special circumstances were noted. This is a routine board composition adjustment, not an abrupt departure. Watch for any future filings regarding compensation or governance changes.
